positive-psychology-virtues.alt: Six boxes. Wisdom: creativity, curiosity, love of learning, perspective. Courage: bravery, perseverance, honesty, zest. Humanity: love, kindness, social intelligence. Justice: teamwork, fairness, leadership. Temperance: forgiveness, humility, prudence, self-regulation. Transcendence: gratitude, hope, humor, appreciation of beauty. Your signature strengths are the few you show most and that feel most like you.
